parrafo.es: Shots and Vibes Photography and Glam Studio es un estudio familiar en St. Petersburg: fotografia, cabello y maquillaje bajo un mismo techo. De graduaciones a sesiones de familia y eventos, cada sesion se trata con la misma direccion creativa y el mismo cuidado, respaldado por una calificacion perfecta de 5.0 en Google.
parrafo.en: Shots and Vibes Photography and Glam Studio is a family-run studio in St. Petersburg: photography, hair and makeup under one roof. From graduation shoots to family sessions and events, every shoot gets the same creative direction and care, backed by a perfect 5.0 rating on Google.

hero.imagen_alt: Glam portrait session at Shots and Vibes Photography and Glam Studio, St. Petersburg

parrafo_1.es: Shots and Vibes nacio cuando Danita, detras de la camara, empezo a trabajar junto a sus hermanas: una en maquillaje, una en estilismo y otra en ventas. Lo que arranco como sesiones de modelos creció hasta un estudio propio en el corazon de St. Petersburg, lo bastante grande para que las cuatro trabajaran juntas.
parrafo_1.en: Shots and Vibes started when Danita, behind the camera, began working alongside her sisters: one in makeup, one in hair, another in sales. What started as model shoots grew into a studio of their own in the heart of St. Petersburg, big enough for all four to work side by side.

parrafo_2.es: Hoy el estudio cubre retratos, graduaciones, familia, maternidad y eventos, con cabello y maquillaje disponibles en el mismo lugar. El trabajo habla solo: calificacion perfecta de 5.0 en Google, sesion tras sesion.
parrafo_2.en: Today the studio covers portraits, graduation, family, maternity and events, with hair and makeup available on site. The work speaks for itself: a perfect 5.0 rating on Google, session after session.

items.quote: Our Family has made Shots and Vibes our go to photographer for all of our milestones and family portraits. Very professional, always on time, referrals and sound advice are always given as needed.
When I tell you, you will be blown away by your service, I mean every word! I was apprehensive prior to the photo shoot, but Danita ensured my family and I felt entirely at ease.
The best photographer in St. Petersburg by far, her studio has everything, and what's even more amazing she can have hair, make up, and accessories on location for you at a great price.
